name: pii-anonymizer
description: Browser-based PII anonymizer for Polish legal documents.

scripts.electron:pack: npm run electron:build-renderer && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist: npm run electron:build-renderer && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist:mac: npm run electron:build-renderer && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist:mac:x64: npm run electron:build-renderer && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist:mac:arm64: npm run electron:build-renderer && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist:win: npm run electron:build-renderer && npm run electron:stage && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.test:e2e:electron: npm run electron:build-renderer && npm run electron:stage && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.electron.config.js
